scenes.audio: Are you tired of wrist pain after a long day of work?
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A person with fair skin, late 20s, wearing a sage green linen shirt and a silver minimalist watch, holds a sleek matte black ergonomic wireless mouse. The camera uses a slow-motion zoom-in. Lighting is soft, natural window light from the left, creating a gentle rim light on the product. The background is a blurred light-oak wooden desk with a single succulent plant in the distance.

scenes.audio: Standard mice force your forearm into an unnatural position, causing strain.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: Static camera angle from the viewer's perspective. The character's hand is seen shaking slightly while holding a traditional, flat white plastic mouse. The hand then lets go and rubs the wrist joint. The surface is a dark grey felt desk mat. The lighting shifts to a cooler, slightly dimmed tone to emphasize discomfort.

scenes.audio: Introducing the Ergo-Lift. Designed at a fifty-seven-degree angle to mimic your hand's natural resting position.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A slow panning shot from right to left across the matte black mouse. The camera focuses on the 57-degree vertical angle and the textured thumb rest. High-contrast studio lighting highlights the metallic scroll wheel. The color grading is highly saturated with deep blacks and sharp details.

scenes.audio: It features silent-click buttons and a precision sensor that works on any surface, including glass.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The person from scene 1 is sitting upright with good posture, smiling slightly. They are using the mouse effortlessly on the oak desk. The camera moves in a smooth tracking arc around the subject. The lighting is warm and bright. The person clicks the silent buttons, showing no visible finger strain.

scenes.audio: Whether you are editing video or crunching numbers, it stays comfortable for hours on end.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: The character is in a bright, modern home office setting with large windows and white walls. They transition from a sitting desk to a standing desk while holding the mouse. The environment includes a bookshelf, a designer lamp, and a coffee mug. The camera uses a speed ramp to show the transition quickly.

scenes.audio: Honestly, I could never go back to a regular mouse now.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The person looks directly into the lens, nodding. Their expression is genuine and relaxed. They give a small 'thumbs up' gesture with their left hand while their right hand remains resting on the mouse. The depth of field is shallow, blurring the room behind them.

scenes.audio: Upgrade your workspace today. Link in bio for twenty percent off.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: The mouse is centered on the grey felt mat. The person's hand enters the frame from the top and clicks the scroll wheel once. The camera does a quick digital zoom-out. The lighting is bright and even, with a clean, professional finish.
